title: Business-Wrap design pack
description: A design pack points at DTCG token files and names the layout rules. design/build.py compiles it to theme.json (the renderer's flat theme) after the palette contrast gate passes. Ships with no logos and no font binaries.

palette.description: Relative path to a DTCG colour token file with color.ramp, color.role, color.diagram, color.white and $extensions.business-wrap.contrastPairs

typography.description: Relative path to a DTCG file with font.family (text, display), font.weight, font.size, font.lineHeight, space, rule, page

fonts.description: Relative path to a font manifest (fonts/manifest.json shape)
